description: Word (.docx) templates for Laravel on PHPWord: filesystem disks, variables, blocks, table rows, images, Eloquent models, safe escaping, downloads and PDF through LibreOffice

author: Kamil Ćwiertnia
description: Laravel client for UniFi Network: official API and classic controller API for sites, devices, clients, hotspot guests, vouchers, Wi-Fi and events.

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Who Said It? A daily quiz made from your forum's own posts: five real quotes, four members each, pick who wrote it. Speed bonus, streaks, a shareable result grid, daily and all-time leaderboards, and yesterday's answers.

author: Kamil Ćwiertnia
description: Laravel client for the Proxmox VE API: nodes, QEMU VMs, LXC containers, snapshots, backups, storage, tasks with a UPID waiter, cluster resources and access, for many clusters.

author: Kamil Ćwiertnia
description: Laravel client for the ISPConfig 3 remote API: clients, websites, DNS, mail, databases, cron, FTP and backups.

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Forum Pet: a shared mascot the whole community takes care of. It lives in the sidebar, follows the forum's mood, eats and plays once a day with each member, grows from an egg to a special form as the community cares for it, and celebrates milestones and holidays.

author: Cengiz Kemec
description: Discord-inspired social community platform for Flarum 2.0: public visitor browsing, social feed, media, rooms, voice, messaging, moderation and full ACP.

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Community Goals: the whole forum works together toward a shared target. Replies, new discussions, likes, new members or posts in a tag, with a big progress bar, milestone celebrations, top contributors, notifications and optional rewards when the goal is hit.

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Question of the Day: one prompt a day on your forum's front page. Members answer briefly, everyone else's answers stay hidden until you post yours, then react to the best. Streaks, an archive, member-suggested questions with upvotes and a moderation queue, a rollover at your local midnight, and an…

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Mural: one shared pixel canvas the whole forum paints together. One tile per cooldown, smooth pan and zoom on mouse and touch, live updates, seasons with a saved picture and a timelapse, a gallery, stats and moderation tools.

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Fanfare: the forum marks the moment. Member birthdays and join anniversaries, the forum's own birthday, Christmas, New Year's Eve, Lunar New Year, Diwali, Eid, Hanukkah, Halloween and Thanksgiving, each with its own big animated centrepiece, a tune to tap and play, and one-click wishes.

author: Ernest Defoe
description: Sticker Book: members collect stickers in an album. A free pack every day with a flip-and-shine reveal, extra packs for taking part, common to legendary rarities with a pity timer, set badges, race-safe trades of spares, rarest stickers on profiles and sticker reactions on posts.
